text: ここで　そんな　わざを　だして　くるなんて　やるな！

structure.jp: だして　くるなんて

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: て-form plus くる means doing something and bringing it toward the speaker. だして　くる = 'bring out (at me)'.

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a phrase shows surprise or admiration at it. だして　くるなんて = 'to think you'd bring out...'.
